questions.question: Due to water crisis, 28% of the initial population left the village and 50% of the remaining population left the village for pursuing jobs. If presently, 4450 people inhabit the village, what is the ratio of the initial population to the present population?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive remaining = 72% then 50% of that

Net remaining = 72% × 50% = 36%

So Present = 36% of Initial

Ratio Initial : Present = 100 : 36

**∴ Answer = 25 : 9**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

28% population left, then 50% of remaining left, final population = 4450

**Formula used:**

Remaining = Initial × (1 − 28/100) × (1 − 50/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let initial population = P

⇒ After first decrease = P × 72/100

⇒ After second decrease = P × 72/100 × 50/100

⇒ Remaining = P × 36/100

⇒ P × 36/100 = 4450

⇒ Ratio P : 4450 = 100 : 36

⇒ Simplifying = 25 : 9

**∴ The correct answer is 25 : 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Formula

Net change = a + b − (ab/100). For decrease, values are negative.

Population Decay Formula

Final = Initial × (1 − x/100) × (1 − y/100)

Fraction Conversion

72% = 18/25 and 50% = 1/2, so total = 18/25 × 1/2 = 9/25

Ratio Simplification

Divide both terms by common factor to get simplest ratio

questions.question: A solid cylinder of base diameter 4 cm is taken to cast a hollow cylinder of external diameter 12 cm, thickness 0.5 cm and height 15 cm. Find the height (in cm) of the solid cylinder (rounded off to 2 decimal places).

Volume conserved ⇒ solid cylinder = hollow cylinder

Outer radius = 6 cm, inner radius = 5.5 cm

Hollow volume = π × 15 × (6² − 5.5²)

= π × 15 × (36 − 30.25) = π × 15 × 5.75

Solid: π × 2² × H = 4πH ⇒ 4H = 15 × 5.75

**∴ H = 21.56 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Hollow cylinder outer radius = 6 cm, inner radius = 5.5 cm

Height = 15 cm

•

Calculation:

⇒ = π × 15 × 5.75

⇒ Solid volume = π × 22 × H = 4πH

⇒ 4πH = π × 15 × 5.75

⇒ H = 21.56 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21.56 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: If (x² - 1)/(x) = 4 , then find the value of (x⁶ - 1)/(x³) .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given expression reduces to: x − 1/x = 4.

The required expression reduces to: x³ − 1/x³.

Direct algebraic shortcut: If x − 1/x = a, then x³ − 1/x³ = a³ + 3a.

Substitute a = 4: 4³ + 3 × 4 = 64 + 12 = 76.

**∴ The correct answer is 76.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ (x² − 1) / x = 4

⇒ x − 1/x = 4

**Formula Used:**

⇒ a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ We need to find the value of (x⁶ − 1) / x³.

⇒ (x⁶ − 1) / x³ = (x⁶ / x³) − (1 / x³)

⇒ (x⁶ − 1) / x³ = x³ − 1/x³

⇒ Applying the algebraic formula where a = x and b = 1/x:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3 × x × (1/x) × (x − 1/x)

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x − 1/x)

⇒ Substitute the value (x − 1/x) = 4:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 4³ + 3 × 4

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 64 + 12

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 76

**∴ The correct answer is 76.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cubic Identity (Sum)

If x + 1/x = a, then x³ + 1/x³ = a³ − 3a.

Square Identity (Sum and Difference)

If x + 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² − 2.

If x − 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² + 2.

Relationship Between Sum and Difference

(x + 1/x)² − (x − 1/x)² = 4.

questions.question: A grocer marked his goods at 75% above their cost price and sold them at a discount of X%. If he gained 33% profit, then find the value of X.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Marked price = 175% of CP

Profit 33% ⇒ SP = 133% of CP

So, SP = MP × (1 − X/100)

133 = 175 × (1 − X/100)

**∴ X = 24%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked price = 75% above CP, Profit = 33%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (1 − Discount/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = 100

⇒ MP = 100 + 75 = 175

⇒ SP = 100 + 33 = 133

⇒ 133 = 175 × (1 − X/100)

⇒ 133/175 = 1 − X/100

⇒ 0.76 = 1 − X/100

⇒ X/100 = 0.24

⇒ X = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price Concept

Marked price = CP × (1 + markup/100)

Discount Formula

SP = MP × (1 − discount/100)

Profit Percentage

Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

Combined Concept

SP can be equated from both MP and CP relations to find unknown discount

questions.question: Find the greatest number that exactly divides 46, 98 and 74.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Greatest number that divides all = HCF

Find pairwise differences: 98 − 46 = 52, 74 − 46 = 28

Now find HCF of 46, 52, 28

HCF = 2

**∴ Answer = 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers = 46, 98, 74

**Formula used:**

HCF = Product of common prime factors with smallest powers

**Calculation:**

⇒ 46 = 2 × 23

⇒ 98 = 2 × 7 × 7

⇒ 74 = 2 × 37

⇒ Common factor = 2

⇒ HCF = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF Definition

HCF is the greatest number that divides all given numbers exactly.

Prime Factor Method

Take only common prime factors with minimum powers.

Difference Method

HCF of numbers also divides their differences.

Relation of HCF & LCM

For two numbers: HCF × LCM = Product of numbers

questions.question: A father’s current age is three times his son’s age. Together, their ages add up to 48 years. How old is the son?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use ratio directly: Father : Son = 3 : 1

Total parts = 3 + 1 = 4

Each part = 48 ÷ 4 = 12

Son’s age = 1 part

**∴ Answer = 12 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Father’s age = 3 × Son’s age, Total age = 48

**Formula used:**

Let son’s age = x, then father’s age = 3x

**Calculation:**

⇒ x + 3x = 48

⇒ 4x = 48

⇒ x = 48 ÷ 4 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Method

If quantities are in ratio a:b, total parts = a + b

Linear Equation

Form equation using variables and solve step-by-step

Age Problems Trick

Present age relations remain constant unless time is changed

Sum Concept

Total age = sum of individual ages

questions.question: Three pipes A, B and C can fill an empty tank in 30 minutes, 40 minutes and 45 minutes, respectively. All three pipes are opened at the same time to disperse liquid chemicals X, Y and Z from pipes A, B and C respectively. After 5 minutes, what is the proportion of chemical Y in the tank?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of chemicals = ratio of efficiencies

Efficiency ∝ 1/time ⇒ A : B : C = 1/30 : 1/40 : 1/45

LCM ⇒ 120 : 90 : 80

Total = 290 ⇒ Y = 90

**∴ Answer = 9 : 29**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Pipe A fills in 30 minutes

Pipe B fills in 40 minutes

Pipe C fills in 45 minutes

All pipes run for 5 minutes

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of given times

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work by A in 5 min = 120 × 5 = 600

⇒ Work by B in 5 min = 90 × 5 = 450

⇒ Total work = 600 + 450 + 400 = 1450

⇒ Proportion of Y = 450 ÷ 1450

questions.question: Find the mean proportional of 17 and 272?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(a × b).

⇒ Mean proportional = √(17 × 272)

⇒ √(17 × 17 × 16)

⇒ 17 × 4 = 68

**∴ The correct answer is 68.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Two numbers are 17 and 272.

**Formula Used:**

If x is the mean proportional between numbers a and b, then a : x :: x : b, which implies x² = a × b.

 
 
 17 : x = x : 272
 x² = 17 × 272
 Mean Proportional Formula

**Calculations:**

Let the required mean proportional be x.

⇒ 17 : x :: x : 272

⇒ 17 ÷ x = x ÷ 272

⇒ x² = 17 × 272

⇒ x² = 17 × (17 × 16)

⇒ x = √(17 × 17 × 4 × 4)

⇒ x = 17 × 4

⇒ x = 68

**∴ The correct answer is 68.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Third Proportional

For any two numbers a and b, the third proportional c is defined such that a : b = b : c. It can be directly calculated as c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For any three numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional d is defined such that a : b = c : d. It is calculated as d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied together, it is known as a compound ratio. For ratios a : b and c : d, their compound ratio is (a × c) : (b × d).
</p

questions.question: The number of prime numbers between 445 and 456 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

List the odd numbers between 445 and 456 not ending in 5: 447, 449, 451, 453.

447 and 453 are divisible by 3 (sum of digits is divisible by 3).

451 is divisible by 11 (4 − 5 + 1 = 0).

449 is not divisible by any prime ≤ √449 (i.e., ≤ 21), making it the only prime number.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

We need to find the number of prime numbers in the range between 445 and 456.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The integers between 445 and 456 are: 446, 447, 448, 449, 450, 451, 452, 453, 454, 455.

⇒ Eliminate all even numbers (divisible by 2): 447, 449, 451, 453, 455.

⇒ Eliminate numbers divisible by 5 (ending in 5): 447, 449, 451, 453.

⇒ Check for divisibility by 3 (sum of digits must be divisible by 3):

⇒ 447 → 4 + 4 + 7 = 15 (Divisible by 3)

⇒ 453 → 4 + 5 + 3 = 12 (Divisible by 3)

⇒ The remaining numbers to check for primality are 449 and 451.

⇒ Check 451: It is divisible by 11 (451 = 11 × 41).

⇒ Check 449: The square root of 449 is approximately 21.2. Testing primes up to 21 (2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19), 449 is not divisible by any of them. Thus, 449 is a prime number.

⇒ Total prime numbers found between 445 and 456 = 1 (which is 449).

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Number Definition

A prime number is a positive integer greater than 1 that has exactly two distinct positive divisors: 1 and itself.

How to Check Primality

To check if a number N is prime, you only need to test its divisibility by all prime numbers up to √N.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places is 0 or a multiple of 11.
</p

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 17, 64, 55, 37, 65, 12, 51, 18 and 59 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Assumed Mean = 40.

Deviations from 40: −23, +24, +15, −3, +25, −28, +11, −22, +19.

Net deviation sum = (+94) + (−76) = +18.

Average deviation = +18 ÷ 9 = +2.

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average Deviation = 40 + 2 = 42.

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 17, 64, 55, 37, 65, 12, 51, 18, 59.

Total number of observations (n) = 9.

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Assumed Mean (40)
 
 Actual Mean (42)
 

 Average Deviation = +2
 Final Result: Mean = 42

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of observations = 17 + 64 + 55 + 37 + 65 + 12 + 51 + 18 + 59

⇒ Sum of observations = 378

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 378 ÷ 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Assumed Mean Method

It simplifies calculations by assuming a central value as the mean and then adjusting it by adding the average of the deviations calculated from this assumed mean.

Arithmetic Mean

It is the simple average of a given set of numbers, calculated as the sum of all values divided by the total number of values.

Weighted Average

When values have different significance, the weighted average is calculated by multiplying each value by its weight, summing the results, and dividing by the sum of the weights.
</p

questions.question: A sum of ₹33,600 is divided among X, Y and Z. X gets ₹4,000 more than Y and Z gets ₹8,000 more than Y. Find the ratio of the amount received by X, Y and Z.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Y = x

X = x + 4000, Z = x + 8000

Total = x + (x + 4000) + (x + 8000) = 33600

3x + 12000 = 33600 ⇒ x = 7200

**∴ Ratio = 11200 : 7200 : 15200 = 14 : 9 : 19**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = 33600

X gets 4000 more than Y

Z gets 8000 more than Y

**Formula used:**

Total = Sum of individual shares

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Y = x

⇒ X = x + 4000

⇒ Z = x + 8000

⇒ Total = x + (x + 4000) + (x + 8000)

⇒ 3x + 12000 = 33600

⇒ 3x = 21600

⇒ x = 7200

⇒ X = 11200, Y = 7200, Z = 15200

⇒ Ratio = 11200 : 7200 : 15200

⇒ Divide by 800 ⇒ 14 : 9 : 19

**∴ The correct answer is 14 : 9 : 19.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation Method

When differences are given, assume one variable and express others in terms of it.

Ratio Simplification

Divide all terms by their HCF to get simplest ratio.

Distribution Concept

Total amount equals sum of individual shares.

Shortcut Tip

Always assign the smallest variable as x for quick solving.

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of angle R and angle S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and angle STR = 27.5^circ . If the ratio of angle P to angle Q is 5 : 6 , then what is the difference between the measures of angle Q and angle P ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The angle formed by the bisectors of two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral is half the sum of the remaining two angles.

⇒ ∠STR = (∠P + ∠Q) ÷ 2

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 27.5° × 2 = 55°

Given the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 5 : 6, the difference is 1 part out of 11 total parts.

⇒ Difference = (1 ÷ 11) × 55° = 5°

**∴ The correct answer is 5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In quadrilateral PQRS, bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at T.

∠STR = 27.5°

Ratio of ∠P to ∠Q = 5 : 6

**Formula Used:**

Sum of interior angles in a quadrilateral = 360°

Sum of interior angles in a triangle = 180°

**Calculations:**

In ΔSTR, the sum of all angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠STR + ∠TSR + ∠TRS = 180°

Since ST and RT are the bisectors of ∠S and ∠R respectively:

⇒ ∠TSR = ∠S ÷ 2

⇒ ∠TRS = ∠R ÷ 2

⇒ 27.5° + (∠S ÷ 2) + (∠R ÷ 2) = 180°

⇒ (∠S + ∠R) ÷ 2 = 180° − 27.5° = 152.5°

⇒ ∠S + ∠R = 305°

In quadrilateral PQRS, the sum of all internal angles is 360°.

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + 305° = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 55°

Let ∠P = 5x and ∠Q = 6x.

⇒ 5x + 6x = 55°

⇒ 11x = 55° ⇒ x = 5°

The difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P is 6x − 5x = x.

⇒ Difference = 5°

**∴ The correct answer is 5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle Bisectors in a Quadrilateral

The angle formed by the intersection of the bisectors of any two consecutive angles of a quadrilateral is always equal to half the sum of the remaining two non-intersecting interior angles.

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of interior angles of an n-sided polygon is calculated using the formula (n − 2) × 180°. For a standard quadrilateral (n = 4), the sum is 360°.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

If all four vertices of a quadrilateral lie on the circumference of a circle, the sum of its opposite angles is exactly 180° (∠P + ∠R = 180° and ∠Q + ∠S = 180°).
</p

questions.question: The average of 7 numbers is 23. If each number is increased by 4, what will the new average be?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If each observation in a dataset is increased by a constant value **k**, the new average also increases by the same constant **k**.

Given Original Average = 23

Value increased per number = +4

⇒ New Average = 23 + 4 = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of values (n) = 7

Original average = 23

Increase per value = 4

 
 
 Original Average = 23
 
 
 
 +4

 
 

 

 

 
 
 New Average = 27

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Number of values

New Average = New Sum ÷ Number of values

**Calculations:**

⇒ Original Sum = 23 × 7 = 161

⇒ Total increase for all 7 numbers = 7 × 4 = 28

⇒ New Sum = Original Sum + Total Increase

⇒ New Sum = 161 + 28 = 189

⇒ New Average = 189 ÷ 7

⇒ New Average = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Property of Addition − Subtraction

If a constant value is added to or subtracted from every term in a dataset, the average of the dataset increases or decreases by that exact constant respectively.

Property of Multiplication − Division

If every term in a dataset is multiplied or divided by a non-zero constant, the new average is the old average proportionately multiplied or divided by that constant.

Combined Average

If group 1 has n₁ items with average A₁ and group 2 has n₂ items with average A₂, the Combined Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
</p

questions.question: A man buys apples at ₹15 per apple and plans to sell them at a 13% profit. How many apples must he sell to make a total profit of ₹195?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit per apple = 13% of 15 = 1.95

Total profit = 195

Number of apples = 195 ÷ 1.95

= 100

**∴ Answer = 100 apples**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost price per apple = 15

Profit = 13%

Total profit = 195

**Formula used:**

Profit per unit = CP × Profit% ÷ 100

Total profit = Profit per unit × Number of units

**Calculation:**

⇒ Profit per apple = 15 × 13 ÷ 100 = 1.95

⇒ Let number of apples = n

⇒ Total profit = 1.95 × n

⇒ 1.95n = 195

⇒ n = 195 ÷ 1.95

⇒ n = 100

**∴ The correct answer is 100 apples.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Percentage

Profit% = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100

Unitary Method

First find profit per unit, then divide total profit by it.

Selling Price

SP = CP × (1 + Profit/100)

Direct Shortcut

Number of units = Total profit ÷ Profit per unit

questions.question: {If } 20\% { of } 50\% { of } (5)/(9) { of a number is } 364, { find the number.}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

20% = 1/5, 50% = 1/2

So total fraction = (1/5) × (1/2) × (5/9) = 1/18

1/18 of number = 364

Number = 364 × 18

**∴ Answer = 6552**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of 50% of 5/9 of a number = 364

**Formula used:**

Percentage = Fraction form

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = x

⇒ 20% = 20/100 = 1/5

⇒ 50% = 50/100 = 1/2

⇒ Equation: (1/5) × (1/2) × (5/9) × x = 364

⇒ (1/18) × x = 364

⇒ x = 364 × 18

⇒ x = 6552

**∴ The correct answer is 6552.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

20% = 1/5, 50% = 1/2 for faster calculation.

Successive Multiplication

When multiple percentages apply, multiply them as fractions.

Inverse Operation

To find original value, divide by fraction or multiply by reciprocal.

Shortcut Tip

Simplify fractions early to avoid large calculations.

questions.question: A train, 150 m long, takes 30 seconds to cross a platform 350 m long. Find the speed (in km/hr) of the train.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 150 + 350 = 500 m

Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 500 ÷ 30

= 50/3 m/s

Convert ⇒ × 18/5 ⇒ 50/3 × 18/5 = 60

**∴ Answer = 60 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of train = 150 m

Length of platform = 350 m

Time = 30 seconds

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance covered = 150 + 350 = 500 m

⇒ Speed = 500 ÷ 30 = 50/3 m/s

⇒ Convert m/s to km/hr ⇒ multiply by 18/5

⇒ Speed = (50/3) × (18/5)

⇒ = 60 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 60 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Train Crossing Platform

Distance = Length of train + Length of platform.

Unit Conversion

1 m/s = 18/5 km/hr.

Speed Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time.

Shortcut Tip

Combine distance first, then directly convert units.

questions.question: The area of a rectangle is 100.64 { cm}² . If its breadth is 7.4 { cm} , find the perimeter of the rectangle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Length = Area ÷ Breadth = 100.64 ÷ 7.4

= 13.6 cm

Perimeter = 2(l + b) = 2(13.6 + 7.4)

= 2 × 21 = 42 cm

**∴ Answer = 42 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of rectangle = 100.64 cm²

Breadth = 7.4 cm

**Formula used:**

Area = Length × Breadth

Perimeter = 2(l + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Length = Area ÷ Breadth

⇒ Length = 100.64 ÷ 7.4 = 13.6 cm

⇒ Perimeter = 2(13.6 + 7.4)

⇒ = 2 × 21

⇒ = 42 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rectangle Area

Area = Length × Breadth

Perimeter Formula

Perimeter = 2(l + b)

Division Tip

Convert decimals to whole numbers for easier division.

Units

Area in cm², perimeter in cm.

questions.question: Two banks, A and B, offered loans at 3.5% and 7% per annum, respectively. Manjit borrowed an amount of ₹5,00,000 from each bank. Find the positive difference (in ₹) between the amounts of simple interest paid to the two banks by Manjit after 2 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in rates = 7% − 3.5% = 3.5%

Principal = 5,00,000, Time = 2 years

Difference in SI = P × R × T ÷ 100

= 5,00,000 × 3.5 × 2 ÷ 100

**∴ Answer = 35,000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = 5,00,000

Rate₁ = 3.5%, Rate₂ = 7%

Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = P × R × T ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI at 3.5% = 5,00,000 × 3.5 × 2 ÷ 100 = 35,000

⇒ SI at 7% = 5,00,000 × 7 × 2 ÷ 100 = 70,000

⇒ Difference = 70,000 − 35,000 = 35,000

**∴ The correct answer is 35,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Rate Difference Trick

Difference in SI = P × (R₂ − R₁) × T ÷ 100

Equal Principal Case

When principal and time are same, directly use rate difference.

Unit Consistency

Always keep rate in %, time in years.

x = 14

questions.question: If 5x⁺y = 3125 and 3³x⁻y = 2187 , then the value of 41x - 32y is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

3125 = 5⁵ ⇒ x + y = 5

2187 = 3⁷ ⇒ 3x − y = 7

Add both ⇒ 4x = 12 ⇒ x = 3

y = 5 − 3 = 2

**∴ 41x − 32y = 123 − 64 = 59**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

5x⁺y = 3125

3³x−y = 2187

**Formula used:**

If am = aⁿ then m = n

**Calculation:**

⇒ 3125 = 5⁵ ⇒ x + y = 5 ...(1)

⇒ 2187 = 3⁷ ⇒ 3x − y = 7 ...(2)

⇒ Add (1) and (2): 4x = 12 ⇒ x = 3

⇒ Substitute in (1): 3 + y = 5 ⇒ y = 2

⇒ Required value = 41x − 32y

⇒ = 41 × 3 − 32 × 2

⇒ = 123 − 64 = 59

**∴ The correct answer is 59.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exponential Rule

If bases are same, equate powers: am = aⁿ ⇒ m = n

Standard Powers

3125 = 5⁵, 2187 = 3⁷

Linear Equations

Solve simultaneous equations using substitution or elimination

Shortcut Tip

Convert numbers into powers first to simplify quickly

questions.question: Two trains of lengths 346 m and 319 m are running with speeds of 67 km/h and 59 km/h, respectively, towards each other on parallel tracks. In how many seconds will they cross each other?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 346 + 319 = 665 m

Relative speed = 67 + 59 = 126 km/h

Convert ⇒ 126 × 5/18 = 35 m/s

Time = 665 ÷ 35 = 19 sec

**∴ Answer = 19 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of train 1 = 346 m

Length of train 2 = 319 m

Speed 1 = 67 km/h

Speed 2 = 59 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 346 + 319 = 665 m

⇒ Relative speed = 67 + 59 = 126 km/h

⇒ Convert speed to m/s ⇒ 126 × 5/18 = 35 m/s

⇒ Time = 665 ÷ 35

⇒ Time = 19 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 19 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two trains move in opposite directions, speeds are added.

Crossing Rule

Total distance = sum of lengths of both trains.

Unit Conversion

km/h to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18.

Shortcut Tip

Always add speeds first, then convert once.
